description: One record per study scope (StudyScope): the versioned boundary of one research project — question, market, time window, language and product categories. Source: PDT v1.3.1 §6.9.

date_window.description: Start and end dates of the study's sampling window

language.description: Language scope of the study, e.g. zh, en, mixed

product_category_ids.description: Product categories under study; may be empty for research not tied to a specific product. A scope label only — it does not automatically assign a product to every mention.

scope_version.description: Scope change bumps the version; published statistics must record the scope_version they used

study_id.description: Globally unique study number, e.g. STU-001

title: Study Scope
